name: orb-duel-replay
description: Run the local duel verification (Node suites, build, Chrome replay of seed 0), then the four-step seed-60 showdown on the same standalone build, and report the observed results.

steps.prompt: Run exactly `node scripts/verify-duel.mjs --browser` from the project root as one shell call. The final response must contain the literal Command and Exit status fields even when the command output does not print its own exit status. Then give the exact Node counts, seed 0, revision, observed Chrome steps, pending step IDs, console errors, SHA-256 and receipt path. Use the actual shell result. On failure state the first failure and the exit status. Do not edit source.
